timeline.summary: Salwinderjit Kaur, as Promoter of Agi Infra Limited, declared no encumbrance on promoter-held shares during FY2025-26 on 03.04.2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹88.12 Cr (+5.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹26.68 Cr (+69.5% YoY).
Agi Infra reported FY26 results with revenue of ₹352.54 Cr and a significant PAT growth to ₹94.86 Cr.
Agi Infra assigned IND A-/Stable rating by India Ratings on ₹2,780 Cr debt facilities
Agi Infra reported Q1FY27 results with revenue of ₹96.44 Cr and PAT of ₹27.54 Cr.
India Ratings upgraded the bank loan facilities of Worldnext Realty LLP to IND BB+/Stable and affirmed the bank guarantee at IND A4+ on September 25, 2026.
Agi Infra board approved a ₹275 Crore QIP fundraise on September 25, 2026, subject to shareholder approval via postal ballot.
Agi Infra held its 21st AGM on September 30, 2026; all five resolutions passed with requisite majority
Agi Infra received RERA approval for its first New Chandigarh project, 'Utopia by AGI', a 31-floor residential development valid until March 2031.
